adjudication.rationale: `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` simply plucks `:topic_id` from `topic_embeds` with no check that the referenced Topic/Post is still valid/visible (`app/models/topic_embed.rb:79-81`). `EmbedController#best` then blindly calls `TopicView.new(topic_id, ...)` when a `topic_id` is returned (`app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:10-14`), with no rescue/fallback to re-enqueue retrieval. Similarly, in `TopicEmbed.import`, the update path assumes `embed.post` is usable (`post = embed.post; PostRevisor.new(post)`), which would raise if the associated post were removed/invalid. The diff shows no mechanism to delete/clear `topic_embeds` on topic/post deletion, so stale `topic_embeds` can plausibly lead to hard errors and no re-import path.
